newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: B.I.G. Industries suspended for results.
newsitem.headline: B.I.G. Industries suspended for results.

text.p: Malaysian industrial gases maker B.I.G. Industries Bhd's stock was suspended on Thursday for release of company results, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said.
The shares last closed at 11.20 ringgit on Wednesday. Company officials could not immediately be reached for comment.

In its results for the year ended Dec. 31, 1995, the company reported net profit of 752,000 ringgit or 22 cents a share on turnover of 26.94 million ringgit. The company went public last December and acquired businesses in October 1995.
Pre-acquisition profits during the 1995 year amounted to 3.30 million ringgit.
In its stock offering prospectus, B.I.G. forecast a net profit of 4.23 million ringgit for the year ending Dec. 31, 1996.
